title: Skill Management
subtitle: Provide your agents with reusable best practices and tools.
gatewayWarning: Gateway is not running. Skills cannot be loaded without an active Gateway.

descriptions.agent-mbti: An AI agent personality and configuration system for establishing a consistent collaboration style.
descriptions.algorithmic-art: A p5.js-based generative art skill for producing repeatable visuals from seeds and parameters.
descriptions.analytics-dashboard: Aggregates metrics and monitoring signals to help you assemble business dashboards quickly.
descriptions.arxiv-reader: A conversational reading and summarization skill for ArXiv papers.
descriptions.arxiv-watcher: Tracks new ArXiv papers continuously and organizes them into a usable research watchlist.
descriptions.brand-guidelines: Turns brand colors, typography, and usage rules into reusable design constraints.
descriptions.pdf: Extracts content, tables, and structured text from PDF files for downstream analysis.
descriptions.xlsx: Reads and analyzes workbook, worksheet, and cell data from Excel files.
descriptions.docx: Parses Word documents, headings, and paragraph text for rewriting and summarization.
descriptions.pptx: Reads slide structure, titles, and text from presentations to surface the key points quickly.
descriptions.find-skills: Finds the most relevant skills for your current task and suggests concrete install paths.
descriptions.self-improving-agent: Helps an agent retain feedback, summarize lessons, and improve future execution.
descriptions.tavily-search: Uses Tavily search to fetch live web information for research-heavy tasks.
descriptions.brave-web-search: Uses Brave Search for web retrieval and returns results that are friendly to agent workflows.
